entries.title: Job 17:1
segments: ¶My spirit is broken, my days are ended, the last resting-place is ready for me.

entries.title: Job 17:2
segments: Truly, those who make sport of me are round about me, and my eyes become dark because of their bitter laughing.

entries.title: Job 17:3
segments: Be pleased, now, to be responsible for me to yourself; for there is no other who will put his hand in mine.

entries.title: Job 17:4
segments: You have kept their hearts from wisdom: for this cause you will not give them honour.

entries.title: Job 17:5
segments: As for him who is false to his friend for a reward, light will be cut off from the eyes of his children.

entries.title: Job 17:6
segments: He has made me a word of shame to the peoples; I have become a mark for their sport.

entries.title: Job 17:7
segments: My eyes have become dark because of my pain, and all my body is wasted to a shade.

entries.title: Job 17:8
segments: The upright are surprised at this, and he who has done no wrong is troubled because of the evil-doers.

entries.title: Job 17:9
segments: Still the upright keeps on his way, and he who has clean hands gets new strength.

entries.title: Job 17:10
segments: ¶But come back, now, all of you, come; and I will not see a wise man among you.

entries.title: Job 17:11
segments: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the desires of my heart.

entries.title: Job 17:12
segments: They are changing night into day; they say, The light is near the dark.

entries.title: Job 17:13
segments: If I am waiting for the underworld as my house, if I have made my bed in the dark;

entries.title: Job 17:14
segments: If I say to the earth, You are my father; and to the worm, My mother and my sister;

entries.title: Job 17:15
segments: Where then is my hope? and who will see my desire?

entries.title: Job 17:16
segments: Will they go down with me into the underworld? Will we go down together into the dust?
